mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_budget_transaction (tx_no, request_id, budget_type, target_id, user_id, tx_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, currency, remark) VALUES (#{txNo}, #{requestId}, #{budgetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{txType}, #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{currency}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tx_no, request_id, budget_type, target_id, user_id, tx_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, currency, remark, created_at FROM ai_budget_transaction WHERE request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY id ASC
